messages.subject: Project Falcon - mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

We act for Bracken Group plc in connection with the proposed acquisition of Greaves Precision Components Limited. Please find attached a mutual non-disclosure agreement for your clients' review. It is in fairly standard form - 2-year term, mutual, with the usual non-solicitation and no-poaching provisions.

We'd be grateful if you could turn this around quickly so we can open the data room. Do let me know if you have any comments.

Kind regards
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
